entities.summary: Titus Ampius Balbus, son of Titus, was a Plebeian politician of Ancient Rome. He was of the Ampia gens, members of the Roman tribe of Horatia, and lived in the 1st century BCE. The writer Cicero called him "the trumpet of the Civil War".
